info.title: AI Video Studio
info.description:
Agent-facing API. Branch on the `code` field of an error, never on its prose.
In server mode every call carries `Authorization: Bearer avs_…`; scopes are read, produce, publish, admin.
Name the channel explicitly (body.channelId, ?channel= or X-AVS-Channel) — the active channel is only a default.
Send an Idempotency-Key (or clientRef on a create) so a retry after a timeout cannot spend twice.
Poll GET /events?after=<id> for progress; a WebSocket at /ws carries the same feed live.

code.description: Stable machine word. Branch on this, never on `error`.

error.description: Short reason, in the user's language unless ?lang= says otherwise.

topic.description: First 200 characters only in list replies.

id.description: Cursor. Pass the last one you saw as ?after=.

bearer.description: Mint with `npm run token -- create` on the machine running the server.

get.summary: Liveness, dependency status and the ops state. Open — no token needed.
Everything the interface needs for a first paint, in one round trip.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel id. Also accepted as X-AVS-Channel or body.channelId. Defaults to the token’s channel, then the active one.

get.summary: Every channel, with the active one named.
Project summaries for a channel, newest first.

post.summary: Create a project. Send clientRef (or an Idempotency-Key header) so a retry cannot create a second one.

clientRef.description: Your own reference. Unique per channel; a repeat returns the first project with reused:true.

config.description: Overrides layered over channel defaults and the default preset.

get.summary: One project. ?scenes=lite drops the generated page from every scene; ?scenes=0 returns the project alone.

put.summary: Edit title, topic, aspect ratio, config or metadata.

delete.summary: Delete a project and its files.

post.summary: Run the pipeline. Returns as soon as the job is queued.

Continue a stopped or held run.
Start again as a NEW project; the previous attempt survives for comparison.
Pass the scene gate: the only thing that stamps scenes_approved_at and lets TTS spend.

get.summary: Characters still to synthesize, the resolved provider and the cost.

Many topics at once; the scheduler runs them one at a time.

This project’s run history.

get.summary: Durable event feed. Without ?after= it returns the current head, so a first call subscribes rather than replaying history.
